name: Yami Choukyou Sin
source:
Main character is a student who is secretly a "trainer" for nasty women. For him women are just tools to make money. However, one day he encounters a woman at school that he passionately lusts for...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名学生，背地里却以调教恶女为业。在他眼中，女人不过是赚钱的工具。然而某天，他在学校遇见了一名令自己欲火难耐的女人……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
